comment: Expected shape of DELIVERED (status OK) records, from the listing claims: every successful narration row carries a title, the voice used, character counts, a positive audio duration, a format and a public download URL — these are structural, produced by the actor itself, so all floors are 100%. The table is confirmed against the staging census before publish (see BUILD_NOTES.md); the census never raises a floor above what the listing claims.

audioSeconds.basis: Structural: probed from the delivered audio file.

audioUrl.basis: Structural: the record's reason to exist — a public KV download URL.

charactersBilled.basis: Structural: billed units for the script, always >= 1 on OK rows.

format.basis: Structural: echoed from the run's outputFormat.

title.basis: Structural: caller title or generated 'Script N'.

voice.basis: Structural: echoed from the resolved input voice.
